modules.name: catalog
modules.responsibility: immutable relation schemas, index definitions and normalization

modules.name: versions
modules.responsibility: per-key version chains and visibility, retention pruning

modules.name: journal
modules.responsibility: checksummed framed fsync records, tail recovery and ordering

modules.name: index
modules.responsibility: typed sorted secondary access candidates with historical supersets

modules.name: query
modules.responsibility: predicate binding, access selection, projection, ordering and aggregation

modules.name: snapshot
modules.responsibility: checksummed atomic checkpoint and immutable backup envelopes

modules.name: engine
modules.responsibility: transaction lifecycles, conflict and constraint validation before durable publish

modules.name: transport
modules.responsibility: bounded HTTP decoding and error/result mapping

modules.name: syntax
modules.responsibility: SQL subset lexer/parser to the same bound query and transaction semantics

modules.name: changelog
modules.responsibility: bounded retained change archive with lineage base and atomic pruning

modules.name: consumer
modules.responsibility: independent relational mirror with durable watermark and idempotent commit application

modules.name: downstream
modules.responsibility: separate downstream HTTP process exposing sync, reinitialize and local queries

workflows.name: typed relation admission
workflows.success: typed relation admission produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: invalid schema leaves no relation

workflows.name: snapshot transaction staging and commit
workflows.success: snapshot transaction staging and commit produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: first committer wins; unique validation against current full resulting state

workflows.name: repeatable reads and read own writes
workflows.success: repeatable reads and read own writes produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: active transactions retain versions; unsupported timestamp rejected

workflows.name: single-column unique and ordered secondary index
workflows.success: single-column unique and ordered secondary index produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: failed unique build leaves no catalog entry

workflows.name: indexed candidates and residual selection
workflows.success: indexed candidates and residual selection produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: historical snapshot always rechecks visible versions

workflows.name: SELECT SQL subset and aggregates
workflows.success: SELECT SQL subset and aggregates produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: syntax errors cannot partially execute; SQL and structured query agree

workflows.name: concurrent writes and atomic abort
workflows.success: concurrent writes and atomic abort produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: no partial commit or sequence advance on conflict

workflows.name: checkpoint plus journal replay
workflows.success: checkpoint plus journal replay produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: incomplete final frame truncated; complete corruption fails closed

workflows.name: durable consistent image
workflows.success: durable consistent image produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: previous image survives failed replacement

workflows.name: portable export and empty-directory restore
workflows.success: portable export and empty-directory restore produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: digest and format validated before startup publishes state

workflows.name: commit-bounded change feed
workflows.success: commit-bounded change feed produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: no split transaction at page boundary; watermark is last delivered sequence

workflows.name: snapshot protected version reclamation
workflows.success: snapshot protected version reclamation produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: lowest active read timestamp limits pruning

workflows.name: rollback and closed session behavior
workflows.success: rollback and closed session behavior produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: discard private writes, retain no pins

workflows.name: query execution facts and database resource state
workflows.success: query execution facts and database resource state produces a verified domain result
workflows.failure: candidates vs scanned vs returned have distinct meanings

workflows.name: independent downstream catch-up
workflows.success: downstream applies complete commits and reports a durable watermark equal to the source head
workflows.failure: page or page budget exhausted reports caught_up=false without overstating the watermark

workflows.name: downstream disconnect, restart and resume
workflows.success: restart resumes exactly after the durable watermark and catches up to a head written while down
workflows.failure: no applied transaction becomes visible in half after replay

workflows.name: duplicate page delivery and transaction atomicity
workflows.success: redelivered commits are counted as duplicates and leave rows and watermark unchanged
workflows.failure: a multi-write transaction is never split at a visible page boundary

workflows.name: retention budget, lag window and reinitialization
workflows.success: slow consumers inside their window are protected while the archive stays inside its byte budget
workflows.failure: a consumer beyond its window gets a stale-cursor error and must reinitialize from a bootstrap

workflows.name: identity and epoch reject a rebuilt source
workflows.success: a source rebuilt from a backup is refused even when sequence numbers overlap
workflows.failure: the only recovery is a bootstrap that adopts the new epoch and records origin

workflows.name: source self-restore breaks consumer history
workflows.success: restored source keeps its source_id, issues a new epoch and refuses old cursors with 410
workflows.failure: a consumer resumes only after reinitializing at the restored lineage point
